title: Verified results feed — completed 2026 regular-season games

source.label: NFL.com by-week schedules, weeks 1-10 of the 2026 season

method: Every score transcribed line by line from the official NFL.com by-week schedule page for its week (retrieved 2026-11-14, chunks 0-1 of each page).

Each row then diffed against the fingerprinted nflverse/nfldata mirror: teams, scores and date must agree exactly (137 of 137 agree; the mirror is a cross-check only and is never the published source).
Summing the feed reproduces all 32 official NFL.com standings rows (W-L-T, PF, PA) exactly; league points for equal points against (6,291).
why_it_exists: Backtests and ROI need graded outcomes. Before this feed the repository held no officially sourced game results, so no strategy could be settled against the league's own numbers. This feed supplies the outcome half. The price half is still blocked (Q-02): ROI needs a price, and no official source publishes one.

coverage.weeks: 1-10 (Week 10: Thursday final only; Sunday and Monday not yet played)
